# Spencer Tracy Brown

> Official portfolio of Spencer Tracy Brown, an Arizona-based artist, sculptor, creative fabricator, and educator.

## Canonical site
- https://spencertracybrown.com/

## Curriculum vitae
- https://spencertracybrown.com/assets/docs/Spencer-Tracy-Brown-CV.pdf

## Practice
- Sculpture and installation
- Ceramics and material studies
- Drawing, painting, and mixed media
- Object and creative fabrication
- Public art and scenic fabrication
- Visual communication and creative leadership
- Arts education

## About
Spencer Tracy Brown works across physical objects, images, constructed environments, and creative learning spaces. His practice centers material presence, boundaries, protection, transformation, interiority, and the translation of ideas into tangible form.

## Contact
- Email: suntoad@me.com
- Location: Phoenix metropolitan area, Arizona

The canonical homepage, public curriculum vitae, and linked portfolio assets are the authoritative public sources for professional and portfolio information.
